newsitem.title: USA: Highwoods buys 77.1 pct of Crocker.
newsitem.headline: Highwoods buys 77.1 pct of Crocker.

text.p: Crocker Realty Trust Inc said on Monday that Highwoods Properties Inc has acquired 77.1 percent of the company's outstanding shares of common stock pursuant to the terms of a stock purchase agreement.

Highwoods bought 12.85 million shares of the company's common stock owned by AP CRTI Holdings LP, 8.8 million shares owned by AEW Partners LP and 766,000 shares owned by the company's management, which total 22.4 million of the approximately 29.1 million of the company's common shares outstanding, at a price of $11.05243 per share, a statement from Crocker said.
